## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | 金额（百万美元） |
|------|-----------------|
| FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）| $39,306 |
| FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）| $29,878 |

- 同比增长 = ($39,306 − $29,878) / $29,878 = **31.55%**
- 微软官方四舍五入为 **32%**（恒定汇率口径下为 **31%**，汇率影响 $80 million）

**出处：** `financial_statements.txt` 位置 18895 — 合并分部收入表；`press_release.txt` 位置 3115 — "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"。

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

CFO Amy Hood 在财报电话会上对 Intelligent Cloud 分部的官方评述（`transcript.txt` 位置 25060–25100）：

> **"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency.**
> 
> **In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."**

此外，CEO Satya Nadella 在同一电话会上补充了基础设施层面的背景（`transcript.txt` 位置 3568–3805）：

> "We added 31 new datacenters across 5 continents this quarter, bringing the total to 88 this year, as we expand our footprint in response to accelerating demand."
> "Over the last fiscal year, we have reduced dock-to-live times for new GPUs in our largest regions by nearly 50%."
> "All up, we added another gigawatt of capacity this quarter and remain on track to roughly double our overall capacity in just two years."
> "we increased the throughput for Copilot workloads 4X since the start of the year."

**归因因素汇总：**

| 编号 | 归因因素 | 原文关键词 |
|------|---------|-----------|
| A | Azure 收入增长 43%，超预期 | "revenue grew 43%", "ahead of expectations" |
| B | 客户需求持续超过可用容量 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" |
| C | CPU/GPU 集群效率提升 | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" |
| D | 流程改进使新容量更早交付 | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" |
| E | 季度内新增 Azure 容量被快速变现 | "additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" |
| F | GitHub Copilot 消耗超预期（6 月商业模式变更后） | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" |
| G | 基础设施扩张（31 个新数据中心、本季度新增 1 吉瓦） | "added 31 new datacenters", "added another gigawatt of capacity" |
| H | GPU 上线时间缩短近 50% | "reduced dock-to-live times...by nearly 50%" |
| I | Copilot 工作负载吞吐量提升 4 倍 | "increased the throughput for Copilot workloads 4X" |

### 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述

#### ✅ 已发生的事实（描述本季度及此前已实现的状况）

| 编号 | 表述 | 依据 |
|------|------|------|
| A | "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency" | 这是对本季度实际业绩的报告，`transcript.txt` 位置 25060 |
| B | "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%" | 已实现的季度增长数据，同上 |
| C | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | 描述当前（本季度末）状态的判断，位置 25089 |
| D | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | 已实现的效率改进，位置 25089 |
| E | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | 已完成的流程改进，位置 25089 |
| F | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | 本季度内已发生的变现，位置 25089 |
| G | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | 6 月变更后已观察到的结果，位置 25089 |
| H | "we added 31 new datacenters across 5 continents this quarter" | 本季度已完成的事实，位置 3568 |
| I | "we added another gigawatt of capacity this quarter" | 本季度已完成的事实，位置 3568 |
| J | "we increased the throughput for Copilot workloads 4X since the start of the year" | 年初至今已实现的提升，位置 3752 |

#### 🔮 管理层对未来的前瞻性表述

| 编号 | 表述 | 依据 |
|------|------|------|
| L | "remain on track to roughly double our overall capacity in just two years" | "remain on track to" 表示对未来进度的展望，非已完成事实，位置 3568 |
| M | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | 明确使用 "continue to expect"，指 FY27 上半年增速将加快，位置 33007 |
| N | "we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%" | 下季度（FY27 Q1）指引，位置 33007 |
| O | "In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" | 下季度 Azure 增速指引，位置 33007 |
| P | "we continue to expect FY27 capital expenditures will grow year-over-year" | FY27 全年资本开支预期，位置 29719 |
| Q | "we expect FY27 effective tax rate to be approximately 20%" | FY27 全年税率预期，位置 29719 |
| R | "we continue to expect another fiscal year of double-digit revenue and operating income growth" | FY27 全年业绩展望，位置 29719 |

#### 区分依据说明

- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态或描述当前状态的动词（"was", "grew", "added", "increased", "continues to exceed"），指向本季度或截至目前已实现的结果。这些内容可以被财报数据验证。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用预期性措辞（"expect", "remain on track to", "continue to expect", "we expect...to be"），指向未来期间（如下一季度 FY27 Q1 或整个 FY27）的预测、指引或目标。这些表述本质上是管理层对未来的判断，受产能上线节奏、合同签订时点、市场环境等不确定因素影响。

关键区分技巧：注意 **"continues to exceed"**（描述当前持续状态）vs **"remain on track to roughly double...in two years"**（未来目标）；以及 **"this quarter" / "over the last fiscal year"**（已完成）vs **"we expect...for our first quarter" / "FY27"**（未来指引）。
